title: Annual Leave Policy
description: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave requests must be approved by the employee's manager.

title: Remote Work Policy
description: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Roles requiring on-site presence are exempt.

title: Password Requirements
description: Passwords must contain at least 12 characters including uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters. Passwords expire every 90 days.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all employee accounts and VPN access.

title: Laptop Replacement Policy
description: Company laptops are eligible for replacement every four years or sooner if hardware failure is confirmed by IT.

title: Software Installation
description: Employees must submit an IT request before installing licensed software on company-managed devices.

title: Expense Reimbursement
description: Business expenses must be submitted within 30 days of purchase along with valid receipts.

title: Travel Policy
description: Flights and hotels must be booked through the approved corporate travel portal unless an exception is granted.

title: Customer Refund Policy
description: Refunds may be issued within 30 days of purchase for eligible products in accordance with company policy.

title: Ticket Priority Levels
description: Support tickets are classified as Low, Medium, High, or Critical based on business impact and urgency.

title: Data Backup Policy
description: Production databases are backed up nightly. Backup retention is maintained for 30 days.

title: VPN Access
description: Employees working remotely must connect through the corporate VPN before accessing internal systems.

title: Meeting Room Booking
description: Meeting rooms should be reserved through the internal booking system. Unused bookings should be cancelled promptly.

title: Office Access Hours
description: Employees may access the office between 6:00 AM and 10:00 PM using their company ID badge.

title: Code Review Process
description: Every pull request requires approval from at least one reviewer before merging into the main branch.

title: API Versioning
description: Breaking API changes require a new major version while backward-compatible changes increment the minor version.

title: Incident Reporting
description: Security incidents must be reported to the security team within one hour of discovery.

title: Email Retention Policy
description: Business emails are retained for seven years to comply with regulatory requirements.

title: Onboarding Checklist
description: New employees must complete mandatory training, receive equipment, configure MFA, and acknowledge company policies during onboarding.

title: Acceptable Use Policy
description: Company devices and networks must be used only for authorised business activities. Illegal, malicious, or unauthorised use is prohibited.
